description: TASK-F09 corpus balance and live Jev re-score (ADR 0009 Verification, FR-02 band evidence). The golden corpus gained benign cases for every previously malicious-only tool and malicious cases for every previously benign-only tool, so tool name is no longer a class tell. Two fresh runs of scripts/jev_triage_eval.py requested jev-1.14.0 by name (served_model field), 200 cases each, 0 errors/fallbacks. No project id, TypeSafe key or credential is recorded in these files.

reference_runs.description: Committed class-blind runs on the unbalanced corpus (68 benign / 59 malicious / 30 evasion / 10 proof, 167 cases). Kept as the BEFORE arm; not replaced.

tool_tell.method: From the scored rows: a tool is exclusive if it appears in only one ground-truth class; tool-name-only majority accuracy is the fraction of cases correctly labeled by predicting each tool's majority class.

gates.method: Repo methodology (tests/unit/test_jev_class_blind_runs_data.py): band 0.35/0.75; decided accuracy (tp+tn)/(tp+tn+fp+fn); escalation = in-band fraction; AUROC pairwise; ECE 10-bin mean-p vs mean-label.

finding: Hypothesis validated: balancing tool names removes the tell (33 exclusive tools -> 0; tool-name-only majority accuracy 0.7904 -> 0.66) on the same 37 tool names. It also shows the earlier corpus inflated measured accuracy: decided accuracy fell 0.828 -> 0.7935/0.7978 while AUROC is unchanged within run-to-run noise (0.9926/0.9939 -> 0.9911/0.9927). The accuracy gate (≥0.98) and ECE gate (≤0.10) still FAIL, ECE worsening 0.190 -> 0.220, and escalation rises ~6% -> 8-8.5%. Decision informed: F10's band calibration must use this balanced corpus; the earlier class-blind runs are not valid band evidence. No band or production change was made here.
